title: error E0277 on lossy into conversion
prompt: Why does calling `.into()` to convert an `i32` into a `u8` trigger compiler error `E0277`?
answer: `From` and `Into` are reserved for lossless conversions. Because `i32` to `u8` can overflow or truncate, Rust does not implement `From<i32>` for `u8`. Use `TryFrom` or `TryInto` instead.
